229

By Alderman Mortimer. Invitation of East Austin Hose Co. No 4. to the City Officials and
their families to attend their "Annual New Years Ball" to be given on Monday January 1st,
1900.
On motion the invitation was accepted and the clerk directed to return the thanks of the
council.
By Alderman Fischer. Petition of citizens to extend and increase the the width of the side
walk on each side of East 12th Stub. between Lavaca and Rio Grande Stubs.
Read and referred to the Street Committee.
On motion the Council adjourned.

Geo. O. Johnson
City Clerk.


Called Meeting of the City Council
Austin Texas. Dec. 20th 1899.
Hon: Jno: D. McCall. Mayor presiding.
Roll called
Roll called Present. Aldermen. Morris and Stumps. .2.
Absent. Aldermen. Dunham. Fischer. Glass Mortimer & Nolm. .5.
No quorum being present, Alderman Morris moved to adjourn until 7.30. O'Clock P.M. Dec.
21st. 1899. Which motion prevailed.

Geo. O. Johnson
City Clerk.


Adjourned Called Meeting of the City Council
Austin Texas Dec. 21st. 1899.
Hon: Jno: D. McCall. Mayor presiding.
Roll called
Roll called Present. Aldermen. Fischer. Morris and Stumpf. .3.
Absent. Aldermen. Dunham. Glass. Mortimer and Nolm. .4.
No quorum Alderman Fischer moved Call of the Council. Carried. and the Marshal directed to
bring in the absentees. Recess fifteen minutes.
Called to order.
The Marshal reported he was unable to find absentees. Roll Called Present. Aldermen.
Fischer. Morris. and Stumpf. .3.
Absent. Aldermen. Dunham. Glass. Mortimer and Nolm. .4.
Alderman Fischer moved to adjourn. Carried.

Geo. O. Johnson
City Clerk.
